machine: docs/benchmarks/MACHINE.md (i5-13420H, 15.7 GB RAM, C: NTFS 909 GB)

rust_listing_release.source: docs/benchmarks/2026-10-28-folder-listing-step02.json plus a repeat run in slice 6

end_to_end_first_rows_painted.method: scripts/measure-folder-open.ps1: packaged release app, fresh data dir, Enter in the address bar -> first folder-000 row present in the accessibility tree (UIA, 25 ms poll granularity)
end_to_end_first_rows_painted.note: Before the poll-response cap (commit 05d9545) the same measurement was 1112-1256 ms, because the first poll delivered all 196 batches in one IPC response and nothing painted until it was parsed. Capping polls at 8 batches (4096 items) fixed it; full listing still completes progressively after first paint.

scrolling.method: TanStack Virtual: only ~30 of 100,100 rows exist in the DOM at any time (verified in screenshots and the UIA tree while measuring)
scrolling.tier: Smooth (16 ms per frame) - by construction, no dropped-frame tooling in this step
